notes.title: Introducing Cairn
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

It is finally time for us to let you in on what we've been cooking: our next game Cairn, a mountain ascent adventure with an intuitive climbing simulation. 

Read the whole description here - also see the superstars who have joined our team to make this game! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588550/Cairn/

We have created a new climbing simulation that gives you complete freedom to explore the mountain, read the rock face and decide on your route. Climbing is challenging, with difficult sections to navigate, and you will need to use your equipment and pitons wisely. Cairn’s story mode will take you on Aava’s journey, as she sets to conquer a summit no one has  reached before, and you will decide what she’s ready to sacrifice to achieve the ascent.

[previewyoutube=nhyMWuORSuA;full][/previewyoutube]

We'll share more with you soon, but in the meantime [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1588550/Cairn/]wishlist Cairn[/url] and stay tuned by: 
[list]
[*] Joining us on [url=http://discord.gg/thegamebakers]Discord[/url]
[*] Joining our (very occasional) [url=https://bit.ly/NewsletterTGB]newsletter.[/url] 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34554475/6d60c64cf78b1f2fcd7b371b9fdcecf1b1a41ec1.jpg[/img]
After years of secrecy, it feels really good for the whole team to finally be sharing this with you, and we can’t wait to hear your feedback - and show you more!

Until then,
The Game Bakers

notes.title: Haven Community Week is over! Thank you
notes.content:
Haven Community Week is now over! Thank you so much for your participation, all the messages and the submissions to the fan art contest. It was fun for us, we hope it was fun for you all too! 

You will find below a summary of everything we shared, to be sure you didn’t miss a thing!
[list]
[*] The Haven Cutest Creatures contest on Twitter is now over and the winner is Salamash (Oink). What a surprise!). We also shared the story behind the names of the creatures in competition. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34554475/b951f700afa49068569996b406d4089ee1a50159.png[/img]
[*] We unveiled a new Haven t-shirt (and you seem to like it a lot). It was exclusive to our team members, but you can win one with the Haven Fan Art contest. It will also be available this Spring when we re-open our merchandise store. Stay tuned! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34554475/5c54ee9205a52dd2eddd92cfa959c967b6d02dc1.jpg[/img]
[*] We shared [url=https://twitter.com/TheGameBakers/status/1625918234317692929?s=20]10 secrets[/url] about Haven on Twitter. 
[*] With the help of our Discord Community, we created a [url=https://twitter.com/TheGameBakers/status/1626266590588141568?s=20]bingo[/url] of things you should do while playing Haven. Have you filled it already?
[*] You can read a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/983970/view/3669907423783725258]full interview[/url] with Florian Coudray, concept artist who created most of the creatures on Source.
[*] We shared on YouTube Haven’s [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IKsaCsrHuNs]credits video[/url], if you haven't reached the end of the game yet, or just want to enjoy the sensual outro video one more time
[*] Our team shared their [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/983970/view/3669907614196892530]favorite love stories[/url], if you are looking for recommendations on new things to read, watch or play, it’s here.
[*] We shared [url=https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fo/3t2a7986u9gk4yu11bglk/h?dl=0&rlkey=7t4s2olix7ef3j7vi179dgi00]new wallpapers[/url] & the super cute new avatars that Koyorin drew for this Community week.
[*] You shared with us which streamers you would like to see playing Haven together, and you [url=https://twitter.com/TheGameBakers/status/1627396602142035968?s=20]had great ideas[/url], thank you! 
[*] We interviewed [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/983970/view/3669907614207404461]Thomas Brasdefer & Diana Díaz Montón[/url] about translating Haven, which is available in 9 languages.
[/list]

Now, the Community Week is over, but the Fan Art Contest [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/983970/view/3669906790351817443]is still live[/url] for a few more days! I hope you loved it as much as we did.

You can join our [url=https://discord.gg/thegamebakers]Discord[/url] or register to our [url=http://www.thegamebakers.com/haven/]newsletter[/url] to stay in touch until the next Community Week!

notes.title: Play as a same-gender couple in Haven free update available now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Haven is a game about the freedom to love whomever you want, and that’s why we’re particularly happy to bring this free Couple update. You can now choose to play the game with the couple of lovers you prefer: either a woman and a man, two women, or two men.

[previewyoutube=AA5O-yeabIk;full][/previewyoutube]
 
This update will not change the story arc for Haven, and you still play as Yu and Kay, but the game offers more options as to the composition of the couple. Haven can now represent love in a broader way! 

If the alternate characters share a similar look with the original Yu and Kay, they have been recreated to the standards of quality of the original release, with two new fantastic actors giving life to the characters across all 80,000 lines of dialog in the game, new models, and the whole in-game art. Several months of work from our small team!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34554475/abbcaafc4efbf23336e61e85ec3e12283f1ef3e1.jpg[/img]

This update is a bit special to us. Originally, the concept for Haven featured 8 couples, with a diverse range of relationships. It became clear during production that we wouldn’t be able to reach our initial vision for the full cast of characters, so we focused on the two characters you know well. But right after the game launch, we went back to work on this update to add the alternate couples! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34554475/d04b21b423db6224c69546f15fa4cef25e39dbca.jpg[/img]

We’re very proud to be able to provide the lovers’ story in two new ways that more players can identify with. We're looking forward to seeing which Yu and Kay you will play, as you enjoy the two lovers' adventures on planet Source (and catch up with Oink!).

As always, a big thank you for playing our games and your support,
The team at Game Bakers

notes.title: Haven - Sweet Little Things - Free Update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
 
I hope you had a great summer. On our side we kept busy: we launched Haven physical editions with Limited Run and we were working on the first content update for Haven... And that's it, it's ready: Sweet Little Things is available today for free, on every platform! 
 
The update brings:
[list]
[*] [b]Two new costumes[/b] for Yu & Kay: "Streetwear" the hot style in the street, and "Top/Truth" inspired by the style of their origin planets.
[*] [b]A meloglide[/b]: music is a huge part of Haven's experience. Now, you will be able to choose which track of the OST by Danger to listen to while chilling in the Nest or exploring Source.
[*]A [b]concept art gallery[/b]: we know many of you love concept art and we wanted to share a bit of the making of Haven, and the work of our talented art team.
[*]A [b]new kiss[/b] for our two lovers.
[*]And many quality of life [b]improvements[/b] based on your feedback.
[/list]
We hope you will enjoy it ❤️. You can read the full patch note below!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34554475/d9a0645ee5bc831ed12277610daeef9cbf84347b.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34554475/6968dafe3b5bd5d2f2dab73d96aacdbf2afa067a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34554475/0e00f4a94194e6d2342b1081b092058f0d9ec77e.jpg[/img]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[b]Patch note - "Sweet Little Things" - Update 30/09/2021[/b]
[u]Version: v1.1.258[/u]

[b]New features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Two new outfits for Yu and Kay: “Streetwear” and “Top / Truth”. They can be worn after finishing the game 
[*]A Meloglide to listen to the game music of your choice while roaming or hanging out in the Nest 
[*]A gallery to discover artworks and concept art from the making of the game, they unlock during the game
[*]Alternative kiss animation
[/list]
[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*]Load save menu now shows your progression in terms of ship parts and equipment
[*]Multiple capsules can now be crafted at once
[*]After cooking, it's now possible to choose which dish to eat
[*]Bonus loot is now rewarded when pacifying multiple creatures at the same time during combat
[*]Some settings can now be configured differently between the first and second player in co-op
[*]Added more sounds and visual effects to several menus
[/list]
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed main menu music stuttering sometimes
[*]Fixed the scrolling behavior in the settings menu
[*]Fixed an issue when starting a new game where the intro cutscene wouldn't play
[*]Fixed a case where characters would keep their spoon in hand in a post-meal dialog
[*]Fixed a dialog about the slugs dividing into two. They now do.
[*]Fixed a music overlap problem when exiting camping
[*]Fixed vibrations that continued when skipping some cutscenes
[*]Fixed several typos in some texts and dialogs
[/list]

notes.title: Haven - Small update May 5th 2021
notes.content:
Already five months since the release of Haven and we are still amazed by the amount of positive feedback we receive. We read all of your messages! Sometimes we even read them to our families and friends 🤗

We’re releasing today a new patch with some improvements and bug fixes. As always, we appreciate your feedback, your help reporting those issues and your patience as we fix them.

[h2]Update v1.0.222[/h2]

[h3]Improvement:[/h3]
- Balancing on the rust needed to craft, upgrade and repair
- Bridges guarded by Tamajus open automatically after the player uses a flow burst
- The anti-gravity sticks can’t be missed anymore
- Added sound effects when interacting with a Nokk creature
- Improved character navigation after a big jump
- Allowed characters to jump more often
- Improved creatures navigation
- Grass in the menu looks better, even when it’s far

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
- Fixed a softlock after the earthquake event when playing in Arabic language setting
- Fixed a crash when waiting too long in the Nest
- Fixed a freeze while fighting with only one of the two heroes
- Fixed a bug where the game appears blocked due to a tutorial's popup being hidden
- Fixed islet descriptions that did not update properly while being discovered
- Fixed visual glitches on creatures walking close to the edge of an islet
- Fixed controls issues while cooking
- Fixed a bug on the climb interaction when Birble is leaving the islet after a bait
- Fixed a visual glitch on the Nest greenhouse visual
- Fixed a soft lock on the credits scrolling when players played the epilogue twice in the same session
- Fixed a bug on the capsule tutorial dialog in combat
- Fixed some typos
- Misc bug fixes

We hope you continue having fun with the game!

notes.title: Haven - Regular Update February 9th 2021
notes.content:
Thank you so much for your continuous positive feedback on the game! Those 97% positive reviews over the last 30 days really make our day! 
We’re releasing today a new patch with some minor feature additions and improvements and a few bug fixes. As always, we appreciate your feedback, your help reporting those issues and your patience as we fix them.

[h2]Update v1.0.198[/h2]

[h3]Feature addition and improvement:[/h3]
- keyboard remapping: added the possibility to rebind actions to the arrow keys.
- improved resolution options for ultrawide monitors.
- the ability to flowburst doesn't consume flow anymore.
- added a generic animation when using the shower after exhausting every dialog.
- improved the navigation and animations for several creatures.
- improved characters' animations during combat and roaming.
- reduced the save file size.
- added SFX when interacting with a Nokk.

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
- removed the stuttering while playing with a high FPS.
- added corrupted save files management.
- fixed a bug where players could be stuck in an islet after using Birble to teleport during the throw & catch tutorial.
- fixed a bug where players couldn't leave the islet after getting back Kay's pants if going too fast onto the next islet while the characters talk about it.
- fixed a bug where players could miss a mandatory cutscene before the end.
- fixed a bug where players could miss the event to upgrade the gloves after repairing the last ship part.
- fixed a bug where the game appears blocked due to the quick advance feature tutorial's popup being hidden by a fading.
- fixed a bug where the time is frozen if starting a new game after the epilogue.
- the game time does not pass anymore if the game is not focus. 
- correctly display the game time over 24h in the load game menu. 
- fixed Lonako islet where the characters could walk above the void.
- prevent Beruberu to start fighting during the flowburst tutorial.
- fixed a bug that could get the Beruberu stuck if the characters lose it by gliding onto a flying flow thread.
- fixed some missing islet descriptions when discovered.
- fixed several localization issues.
- fixed a bug where a character could end at 0 hp after combat.
- allowed the gamepad stick to be used during the cooking reward popup.
- Misc bug fixes.

notes.title: Haven - Regular Update December 15th 2020
notes.content:
We are amazed by your continuous positive feedback on the game! It’s heartwarming to hear how much you’re enjoying Yu and Kay’s story. We’re releasing today a second patch with some of your most pressing feature requests and some fixes to improve the experience. 
We appreciate your feedback, your help reporting those issues and your patience as we fix them. 

[h2]Patch notes - Update December 15th 2020[/h2]

[b][u]Version 1.0.165[/u][/b]

[h3]Feature addition and improvement:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Automatic backup save before ending[/b]: a save is created for those of you who will want to go back and explore the game before the end. For players who have finished the game already, when loading your epilogue save, a backup save will be created before the take off, giving you a change to revisit.
[*] [b]Co-op with Keyboard & Mouse and one controller[/b]: Ability to play co-op with Keyboard & Mouse + one controller (local and remote play).
[*] [b]Accessibility:[/b] Option to disable camera wobble. 
[*] [b]UI:[/b] Ability to choose what button prompts are displayed
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Gloves upgrade:[/b] Fixed a bug where Yu says she has enough hyper rust to upgrade the gloves, although this upgrade is not accessible yet.
[*] [b]Combat soft lock:[/b] fixed a bug where the characters would become unresponsive after using Help in combat. 
[*] Misc bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Haven Patch notes - Minor Patch December 9th 2020
notes.content:
A big thank you to everyone who’s playing Haven, we are receiving your fantastic feedback about the game and it’s heartwarming. We also enjoyed your first cosplays and fan-arts! 
We’ve prepared already a first patch to cover some of the most urgent fixes. We are working on another one that we will release soon and we will be bringing all of those to PS5 and XBOX (Series, One and Windows) as soon as possible.

We appreciate your help reporting those issues and your patience as we fix them. 

[h2]Patch notes - Minor Patch December 9th 2020[/h2]

Version 1.0.157

[u]Bug fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Turkish regional settings issue:[/b] When playing with Windows regional settings set to Turkish, some menu UI localization would not show up properly and actor voices were missing.
[*] [b]Blocking bug at the big door on Lonako:[/b] Some cases where the big door would not open. Running the update should fix the issue for users currently having the problem in their save game.
[*] [b]Unexpected behavior if you played the demo:[/b] Some users who previously played Haven demo could encounter a crash or unexpected behavior if they continue playing the game from a save from the demo.
[*] [b]Roaming stutter:[/b] Prevent some stutter that could happen routinely every 10-20 seconds while roaming.
[*] [b]Wide screens resolutions improvements:[/b] Display options now gives the choices of resolution wider than 16/9 for ultrawide monitor support and fix main menu out of the screen on very wide resolutions.
[/list]

notes.title: Haven Original Soundtrack: physical editions available to pre-order
notes.content:
Hey everybody,

Haven's Original Soundtrack is composed by French electro musician DANGER (whose work was already featured in Furi). Today, we are thrilled to announce we cooked two physical editions: a double vinyl album and a CD digipack. The pre-orders of the physical editions start now!
[list]
[*] Double vinyl edition ($39/€35): [url=https://www.g4f-records.com/en/produit/haven-edition-vinyl-pre-order/]https://www.g4f-records.com/en/produit/haven-edition-vinyl-pre-order/[/url]
[*] CD edition ($17/€15): [url=https://www.g4f-records.com/en/produit/haven-cd-edition-pre-order/]https://www.g4f-records.com/en/produit/haven-cd-edition-pre-order/[/url]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34554475/231f0ecb2d37edfaf6d75ac11fceb7253ade0f1c.png[/img]

The vinyl edition is inspired by the colourful watercolours of the game intro movie by Yukio Takatsu (Japanese animator and director). The album includes two vinyl records (180 g), yellow and red, in a “pastel grain” textured gatefold cover.  The double CD edition is a 6-panel digipack and includes an 8-page booklet. Shipment of both editions is scheduled for late January 2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34554475/a9fe803d43d6dd10d0832c82b65bc096fad5315c.png[/img]

In the Haven original soundtrack, DANGER returns to his electro synthwave music style, adding more positive and colourful vibes to it, as well as elements of Vaporwave and Funky music, mixed with a new orchestral dimension.

The digital version of the soundtrack will be available December 3rd on Steam and all music streaming platforms. You can already wishlist it here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1468310/Haven_Soundtrack/

If you can't wait, the first single “ 04:42 Still Free” is still available on Steam, Spotify and other platforms. What are you waiting for? Push the volume up and enjoy the music! 😜🎧

The vinyl edition is inspired by the colourful watercolours of the game intro movie by Yukio Takatsu (Japanese animator and director). The album includes two vinyl records (180 g), yellow and red, in a “pastel grain” textured gatefold cover. The double CD edition is a 6-panel digipack and includes an 8-page booklet. Shipment of both editions is scheduled for late January 2021.

In the Haven original soundtrack, DANGER returns to his electro synthwave music style, adding more positive and colourful vibes to it, as well as elements of Vaporwave and Funky music, mixed with a new orchestral dimension.
